predicted_cif.description: Absolute path to the top-ranked predicted CIF for the protein-ligand complex.

affinity_pred_value.description: Predicted log10 IC50 (uM); lower means tighter binding (Boltz-2 affinity head).

affinity_probability_binary.description: Predicted probability that the ligand is a binder (0..1).

confidence_score.description: Confidence score reported by Boltz-2 for the top-ranked structure (from confidence_<id>_model_0.json).

msa_paths.description: Alignment/MSA files generated or materialized by Boltz preprocessing, including remote ColabFold .a3m files when use_msa=true.

msa_index_csv.description: Boltz MSA manifest/index CSV when preprocessing produced one.
